title: Long-duration operations (60 min)
description: A full hour of campus operations. Sixty drones fly repeated sorties; when a drone lands below 35 % charge it flies to a depot swap station first. Each depot serves two drones at a time and the rest queue. A one-minute DTC outage at 20 min tests the hold policy, and at 40 min the operator recalls every drone below 25 %. The battery matrix shows the fleet's charge cycling.

script.reason: shift policy: hold on lost link
